text: Fixing #6518: install-pinned-nsis.ps1's Invoke-WebRequest default browser-like User-Agent makes SourceForge return an HTML mirror-picker page (~148 KB) instead of nsis-3.12.zip, so the (correct) SHA-256 pin rejects it. Verified with pwsh: default UA -> HTML, curl UA -> zip matching the pin. Fix sends a non-browser UA; pin and fail-closed behavior unchanged. Existing macOS failures map to #5809 and #6494 (already tracked, not duplicated).
